newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil sidles sideways.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil sidles sideways.

text.p: NEW high sulphur fuel oil was notionally unchanged on Monday and business was thin, traders said.

High sulphur barges were pegged at around $87/89 a tonne fob ARA shortly before lunch and no trade was heard to have been done. "Not a single tonne has been done as far as I can see," one ARA refinery-based trader said.
High sulphur cargoes were notionally unchanged from Friday's $83/$85 cif NWE but dealers were unwilling to put numbers on cargo prices.
"There is no reason for different prices today," said one occasional buyer of cargoes. "There is very little activity."

Low sulphur fuel oil was in a similar predicament. While arbitrage opportunities with the U.S. appeared to be unworkable at the moment, dealers said a shift in relative prices of a few dollars or more could create new opportunities.
